body_html:
Poems
resonance on
in combined voices
  respond to loss
with love of sheer
   physical pleasure
       languages
sonic textures,
rythms

stand back
shape language to
gain distance
let it go

Sonic textures
marvel in
self expression
becoming
    art
as we let readers in
